question: The Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Kozhikode has developed a light coloured turmeric variety named _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IISR SURYA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR), Kozhikode**, is a renowned institute focused on research and development in the domain of spices.
 
• It has developed a unique light-coloured turmeric variety named **IISR SURYA**, which is designed to cater to specific needs and preferences.
 
• Turmeric is a widely used spice in **India**, known for its culinary, medicinal, and cosmetic applications. The development of new varieties enhances the crop's commercial and agricultural value.
 
• **IISR SURYA** stands out because of its light colour, which can be advantageous for certain markets and industries such as the cosmetic and food industry.
 
• The development of this turmeric variety aligns with the goals of the **Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR)** to innovate and improve spice crops through research and technology.
 
• The light-coloured turmeric variety ensures better adaptability to consumer demands and enhances marketability, especially in regions where lighter turmeric is preferred. *Hence, IISR SURYA is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR):**

 
 
• **IISR Kozhikode** is an institute under the **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)**. It is dedicated to research and development in spice crops such as turmeric, pepper, cardamom, and ginger.
 
• The institute works towards improving the productivity, quality, and sustainability of spice crops through scientific innovation and advanced agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Turmeric:**
 
 
• **Example:** Turmeric is extensively used in Ayurvedic medicine for its **anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial** properties.
 
 
 
• **Development of Spice Crops:**
 
 
• The development of new varieties like **IISR SURYA** reflects the ongoing efforts to align agricultural practices with market demands and consumer preferences.
 
• These innovations contribute to the growth of the spice industry, benefiting farmers and enhancing India's position as a global leader in spice production.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Characteristics of IISR SURYA:**

 
 
• The light-coloured turmeric variety is specifically designed for industries that prefer lighter shades, such as **cosmetic and food processing industries**.
 
• It enhances the marketability of turmeric in regions or countries where lighter turmeric is preferred due to cultural or culinary reasons.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Research:**
 
 
• The innovation by **IISR Kozhikode** contributes to the diversification of spice crop varieties and promotes sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• **Global Recognition:** Such advancements strengthen India’s position as a leading exporter of spices and enhance farmer income.
